blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Joint audio–video generation has advanced rapidly through unified and interacting dual-stream models ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Low et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Team et al., 2026 ) . Yet generated audio and video still struggle to achieve high quality together: either stream may contain perceptual artifacts, one or both may not reflect the text prompt, and otherwise plausible streams may depict mismatched events or drift out of sync. Scaling pretraining alone does not directly prioritize these failures. Reward-guided post-training instead turns perceptual and semantic evaluators into learning signals, with demonstrated benefits in language and visual generation ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . Extending it to joint generation requires improving both streams while preserving their semantic and temporal dependence.
blocks.zh: 联合音频-视频生成通过统一和互动的双流模型(HaCohen等人,2026年;Low等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年c;Team等人,2026年)快速推进. 然而,生成的音频和视频仍然难以共同实现高质量:要么溪流可能包含感知文物,要么溪流可能不反映文字提示,要么溪流可能描绘不匹配的事件,要么漂出同步。 仅扩大预训并不直接确定这些失败的优先次序。 受奖励的后培训则将知觉和语义评价员转变为学习信号,在语言和视觉生成方面表现出来的好处(Rafailov等人,2023年;Shao等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年a年)。 将其扩展至联合生成需要改善双流,同时保持其语义和时间依赖性。

blocks.en: A natural baseline treats each generated audio–video pair as one policy output. For every prompt, it samples groups of paired rollouts, evaluates audio quality and alignment, video quality and alignment, and cross-modal synchronization, aggregates the heterogeneous rewards into a group-relative advantage, and updates both towers ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025 ) . This straightforward joint optimization has three difficulties.
blocks.zh: 自然基线将每个生成的音频-视频对作为政策产出。 对于每一次速率,它都会对成对的推开组合进行抽样,评价音频质量和对齐,视频质量和对齐,以及跨模式同步,将各种奖励组合成群体相对优势,并更新两个塔楼(Shao等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年a; 郑等人,2026;薛等人,2025). 这种直接的联合优化有三个困难。

blocks.en:
First, mixed rewards complicate model optimization and fair reward comparison. Audio quality, visual quality, text alignment, and synchronization may favor different candidates, making their joint optimization difficult.
Moreover, synchronization rewards depend on the sampled counterpart: matching audio to a steady scene can be easier than frequent visual events. A higher score may therefore reflect an easier counterpart as well as better alignment, making comparisons across jointly varying pairs less controlled. Second, joint updates incur high memory costs and can misassign credit. Backpropagation and training states are required for both towers, yet a shared advantage updates both even when its improvement primarily comes from one modality. Their interactions throughout denoising further complicate assigning that improvement to the responsible tower. Third, different modalities have different optimization dynamics. Their pretrained capabilities, latent scales, reward sensitivities, and learning speeds differ. Shared objectives and noise strengths can favor one branch or destabilize the other, making a common configuration unsuitable.
blocks.zh:
第一,混合奖励使模型优化和公平奖励比较复杂化。 音频质量,视觉质量,文本对齐,同步可能有利于不同的候选者,使其联合优化难度大.
此外,同步奖励取决于被抽样的对应方:将音频与稳定的场景匹配比频繁的视觉事件容易. 因此,较高的分数可能反映比较容易的对应方和更好的对齐,使对共同不同的对对对的比较受到较少的控制。 第二,联合更新会造成高昂的内存成本,并可能误配信用. 两座塔都需具备反向布置和培训状态,然而,即使其改进主要来自一种方式,两者都具有共同优势。 它们之间的相互影响使将这种改进分配给负责的塔楼更加复杂。 第三,不同的模式具有不同的优化动态. 其预先训练的能力、潜在尺度、奖励敏感性和学习速度各不相同。 共同目标和噪音力量可能有利于一个分支或破坏另一个分支的稳定,使共同配置不合适。

blocks.en: We propose AV-GRPO , which alternates audio-anchored video optimization and video-anchored audio optimization (Figure 1 ). First, modality-anchored rollouts disentangle rewards and control comparison conditions. Each group shares one complete anchor trajectory while independently sampling the target modality. The anchor reward can be omitted, simplifying optimization to target-modality quality and alignment plus synchronization against a common counterpart. This controls anchor-induced difficulty variation within each group, while refreshing anchors across groups preserves diverse conditions. Second, trajectory locking and tower freezing significantly reduce memory costs and direct credit to the target tower. The anchor states remain fixed throughout each rollout and its policy update, and only the target tower is optimized. Applying the conditional advantage to this tower avoids updating both branches with the same signal; freezing the counterpart also reduces backward-pass and training-state costs. Third, hyperparameter decoupling accommodates different branch dynamics. We use modality-specific reward compositions, noise strengths, and loss weightings to support exploration and stable optimization in each tower. Alternating the target modality allows both towers to improve under controlled cross-modal conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们提议AV-GRPO, 首先,模式化的推出分散了奖励和控制比较条件。 每组在独立取样目标模式时共用一个完整的锚轨。 锚地奖励可以省略,简化优化到目标模式质量,并与共同对应方对齐加同步. 这控制了各组内锚因难度引起的差异,而各组间更新锚则维护了各种条件。 第二,轨迹锁定和塔楼冻结显著降低内存成本,直接信用给目标塔. 锚地状态在每次推出时及其政策更新中始终保持固定状态,只有目标塔被优化. 将有条件的优势应用到这座塔上,避免了以相同的信号更新两个分支;冻结对应物也会降低落后的通过和训练状态的成本. 第三,超参数脱钩可容纳不同的分支动态. 我们使用特定模式的奖励成分,噪声优势,以及减重来支撑每个塔的探索和稳定优化. 改变目标模式可以使两座塔在受控制的交叉模式条件下改进。

blocks.en:
To support controlled post-training, we introduce 5DAV , a training set of 5,760 prompts organized along five independently specified dimensions. We evaluate AV-GRPO on JavisBench and VABench against LTX-2.3 and GDPO under both LoRA and full fine-tuning. The results show broad gains in perceptual quality, text alignment, cross-modal coherence, and synchronization, while ablations test the dataset and the alternating schedule. The frozen-tower strategy also enables full-parameter post-training of the 22B LTX-2.3 model on eight NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
Our contributions are: • We propose AV-GRPO , a modality-anchored reinforcement learning framework that alternates controlled modality-wise updates for clearer reward attribution and balanced audio–video improvement. • We develop three complementary mechanisms: (i) modality-anchored rollouts that disentangle reward objectives and enable controlled synchronization comparisons; (ii) trajectory locking and tower freezing that isolate modality-wise credit assignment while reducing memory overhead; and (iii) decoupled optimization hyperparameters that accommodate asymmetric audio–video learning dynamics. • We introduce 5DAV , a five-dimensionally decoupled training set. Experiments on JavisBench and VABench show broad gains in generation quality, text–modality alignment, and synchronization, supported by ablations.

Flow-GRPO. Online reinforcement learning with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) optimizes the step-by-step sampler as a policy: each denoising step is an action, and the reward is assigned to the final sample. This requires the sampling process to be stochastic, so that different samples can be drawn for the same prompt, and the per-step transition probability to be computable, so that there is a probability ratio to adjust. The deterministic ODE of Eq. ( 2 ) satisfies neither: the same initial noise always yields the same sample,
and computing its transition probability is computationally expensive due to divergence estimation.

Alternating phases then updates each tower under the other’s latest distribution instead of permanently fixing either one.

blocks.en:
To support GRPO optimization for joint audio-video generation models, we construct a 5D decoupled training set (5DAV) that is fully disentangled across five dimensions: semantic hierarchy, sound source type, synchronization difficulty, temporal complexity, and instruction granularity. Through Cartesian product of these dimensions, our dataset achieves comprehensive capability coverage with controllable difficulty levels.
The five dimensions are defined as follows:
blocks.zh:
为了支持GRPO优化联合音频-视频生成模型,我们构建了一个5D脱钩的训练集(5DAV),它完全分散在五个维度上:语义结构,声音源类型,同步难度,时间复杂性,以及指令颗粒性. 通过这些维度的笛卡尔产品,我们的数据集实现了具有可控难度水平的全面能力覆盖.
这五个方面的定义如下:

blocks.en: • Semantic Hierarchy (W) : Entity-level (single object/person/animal and its inherent sound), Scene-level (static scene with background atmosphere), Event-level (dynamic interactions and causal events among multiple entities). • Sound Source Type (H) : Human voice, Environmental and object sounds, Music, Mixed sources (two or more types). • Synchronization Difficulty (D) : Irrelevant (audio and video independent), Category matching (audio category matches the scene), Frame-level synchronization (audio and video fully aligned), Physical causal synchronization (e.g., pitch rising as a train approaches). • Temporal Complexity (T) : Single-event (single scene/event, no scene transition), Multi-event (multiple scenes/causal events, with scene transitions). • Instruction Granularity (C) : Weak constraint (core semantics only), Medium constraint (explicit sound source/scene/event), Strong constraint (fine-grained details including precise timing, spatial position, pitch/volume variations).
blocks.zh: • 语义等级(W):实体级(单一物体/人/动物及其固有声音)、场景级(具有背景气氛的静态场景)、事件级(多个实体之间的动态相互作用和因果关系)。 • 声音源类型(H): 人声,环境和物体的声音,音乐,混合源(两种或两种以上). • 同步难度(D):不相关(音频和视频独立),类别匹配(音频类别与场景匹配),帧级同步(音频和视频完全对齐),物理因子同步(例如,作为列车接近时投球上升). • 时间复杂(T): 单场事件(单场场景/活动,没有场景过渡),多场事件(多场景/因果事件,有场景过渡). • 指示颗粒度(C): 弱约束(只包括核心语义),中约束(明确音源/场景/事件),强约束(精细细的细节,包括精确的时间,空间位置,音位/音量变化).

blocks.en: The five-dimensional decomposition yields 3 × 4 × 4 × 2 × 3 = 288 3\times 4\times 4\times 2\times 3=288 orthogonal categories, with 20 prompts generated per category, resulting in a total of 5,760 data samples. This design promotes comprehensive coverage of audio-video generation application scenarios. Moreover, the sampling ratio of categories within each dimension can be flexibly adjusted according to the requirements of different training stages, enabling the dataset to adapt to diverse optimization objectives and model iteration paces. This design makes the training process traceable and model weaknesses localizable, providing clear guidance for data selection and reward function design.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Reward Models and Reward Composition
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 奖励模式和奖励构成

blocks.en: For video-tower optimization, we use VideoAlign ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and DeSync ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) to assess video quality, video–prompt alignment, and audio–video synchronization, respectively. For audio-tower optimization, we use Audiobox Aesthetics ( Tjandra et al., 2025 ) , CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , and DeSync to assess audio quality, audio–prompt alignment, and audio–video synchronization, respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了实现视频对台的优化,我们使用VideoAlign(Liu等人,2026b),CLIP(Radford等人,2021),DeSync(Iashin等人,2024)分别评估视频质量,视频-即时对台,音频-视频同步. 用于音频至上优化,我们使用音频盒美学(Tjandra等人,2025年),CLAP(Wu等人,2023年),DeSync分别评估音频质量,音频-即时对齐,音频-视频同步.

blocks.en: Following GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026e ) , the video score sums standardized VideoAlign, CLIP, and negative DeSync, whereas the audio score sums standardized audio aesthetics, CLAP, and negative DeSync (Since lower DeSync is better, its sign is reversed). We standardize the resulting score again within the group to obtain the trajectory advantage. For audio, a CLAP guardrail uses only the alignment advantage when the group’s average CLAP falls below a threshold; this prevents quality and synchronization gains from masking a loss of prompt fidelity. Appendix D gives the equations.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 评价基准

blocks.en: We adopt JavisBench ( Liu et al., 2026c ) and VABench ( Hua et al., 2026 ) as our evaluation benchmarks to comprehensively assess the generated audio-video content.
blocks.zh: 我们采用Javis Bench(Liu等人,2026c)和VA Bench(Hua等人,2026)作为评价基准,全面评估所产生的音频视频内容。

blocks.en: JavisBench evaluates generated samples across four complementary dimensions: (1) Unimodal Generation Fidelity , measured by Visual Quality (VQ) and Audio Quality (AQ), assessing the perceptual quality of each modality independently; (2) Text-Modal Alignment , where ImageBind similarity, CLIP score, and CLAP score are employed to measure the semantic consistency between the textual prompt and each generated modality; (3) Audio-Video Semantic Coherence , evaluated via Audio-Video ImageBind similarity (AV-IB) and AVH Score to quantify cross-modal semantic alignment; (4) Audio-Video Synchronization , assessed by JavisScore and DeSync to measure temporal correspondence between audio and video streams.
blocks.zh: Javis Bench在四个互补方面评价生成的样品: (1)以视觉质量(VQ)和音频质量(AQ)衡量的单式生成Fidelity,独立评估每种模式的知觉质量; (2)文本-模块对齐,其中ImageBind相似性,CLIP得分,CLAP得分用于测量文本快感与生成模式之间的语义一致性; (3)音频-视频语义一致性,通过Auso-Video ImageBind相似性(AV-IB)和AVH得分来评估,以量化跨模式语义一致性; (4)音频-视频同步,由JavisScore和DeSync评估,以测量音频和视频流之间的时间对应.

blocks.en: VABench organizes its evaluation into two paradigms. The first paradigm relies on expert models to provide objective perceptual quality assessments, including speech quality and naturalness (SpeechQual&Nat), audio aesthetics (AudioAesthetic), and lip synchronization accuracy (Lip-Sync). The second paradigm leverages Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to simulate human judgments on complex audio-video semantics, covering high-level criteria such as global Alignment, Artistic quality (Artistry), and Expressiveness.
blocks.zh: VA Bench将其评价组织为两个范式. 第一个范式依靠专家模型来提供客观的知觉质量评估,包括语音质量和自然性(SpeechQual&Nat),音频美学(AudioAlectic),和唇同步精度(Lip-Sync). 第二个范式利用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)模拟人类对复杂音频-视频语义的判断,涵盖全球对齐,艺术质量(Artistic Quality (Artisty))和表达性等高级标准.

blocks.en: 3.3 Main Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 主要结果和分析

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 1 and 2 report the results of AV-GRPO under both LoRA and full fine-tuning on JavisBench and VABench. Compared with LTX-2.3 (22B) and GDPO, AV-GRPO consistently improves nearly all metrics under both settings, with full fine-tuned model attaining the best overall performance.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2汇报了AV-GRPO在LORA和Javis Bench和VA Bench两个项目下的结果。 与LTX-2.3(22B)和GDPO相比,AV-GROPO在两种环境下都持续改进了几乎所有的度量衡,完全微调的模型实现了最佳的整体性能.

blocks.en: In terms of perceptual quality, the full fine-tuned model improves AQ on JavisBench from 5.097 to 5.798 and Audio Aesthetics on VABench from 3.319 to 3.631 over LTX-2.3. For semantic alignment, it boosts CLIP on JavisBench from 0.318 to 0.327 and CLAP from 0.408 to 0.468. For cross-modality consistency and synchronization, substantial gains are observed across the board: AVH Score, DeSync, and AV-Align on JavisBench, as well as Lip Sync and DeSync on VABench, all exhibit significant improvements. In all these aspects, AV-GRPO consistently outperforms GDPO by a considerable margin.
blocks.zh: 在知觉质量方面,全微调模型改进了Javis Bench上的AQ从5.097到5.798,VA Bench上的音频美学从3.319到LTX-2.3上的3.631. 对于语义对齐,它将Javis Bench上的CLIP从0.318提升到0.327,CLAP从0.408提升到0.468. 对于跨模式一致性和同步性,全方位观察到了巨大的收益:AVH Score,DeSync,Javis Bench上的AV-Align,以及VA Bench上的Lip Sync和DeSync,都显示出显著的改进. 在所有这些方面,AV-GRPO的成绩一直大大超过GDPO。

blocks.en: The two training regimes show different strengths. Full fine-tuning yields the highest JavisBench AQ and AV-IB scores (5.798 and 0.247), while LoRA attains a slightly higher CLIP score (0.330 versus 0.327) and a lower DeSync value (0.554 versus 0.607). The improvements are therefore broad rather than uniform: LoRA’s VQ is 5.816, below the base model’s 5.855, and the full model’s VABench visual-realism score is 4.395 versus 4.399 for the base model. These exceptions do not change the gains in most quality and alignment measures, but they show that different modalities and training regimes retain distinct tradeoffs.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: 4.1 Joint Audio–Video Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 联合音频-视频生成

blocks.en: Early audio–visual generation methods typically adopt asymmetric pipelines that synthesize one modality conditioned on the other. For example, FoleyCrafter ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and MMAudio ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) generate temporally aligned audio from video. While such methods benefit from strong unimodal priors, their asymmetric formulations limit direct bidirectional co-generation. Recent works instead generate audio and video within a unified process. JavisDiT ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , UniVerse-1 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Ovi ( Low et al., 2025 ) and LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) employ interacting dual-stream architectures with cross-modal fusion. These advances primarily focus on model architecture, data construction, and large-scale pretraining. In contrast, our work studies reward-guided post-training of joint audio–video models, aiming to improve both modalities without entangling their learning signals.
blocks.zh: 早期的视听生成方法通常采用非对称的管道,将一种模式合成到另一种模式。 例如,FoleyCrafter(Zhang等人,2026年b)和MMAudio(Cheng等人,2025年)从视频中生成时间对齐的音频. 虽然这些方法得益于强大的单式前置方法,但其不对称配方限制了直接双向共生成。 近期的作品反而在一个统一的进程中产生音频和视频. 贾维斯迪特 (Liu等人,2026c),UniVerse-1(Wang等人,2025年),Ovi(Low等人,2025年)和LTX-2(HaCohen等人,2026年)采用交互式双流结构与跨模式聚变. 这些进步主要集中于模型架构,数据构建,以及大规模的预训. 反之,我们的工作研究对联合音频-视频模型的后期培训给予奖励,目的是改进这两种模式,同时不限制其学习信号。

blocks.en: 4.2 Reinforcement Learning-based Post-training
blocks.zh: 4.2 加强基于学习的培训

blocks.en: Reward-guided post-training has been widely explored for diffusion and flow-based generation. DDPO ( Black et al., 2023 ) and DPOK ( Fan et al., 2023 ) formulate reverse denoising as a sequential decision process and optimize diffusion models using policy gradients. More recently, Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2026a ) converts deterministic flow sampling into an equivalent stochastic process for online GRPO. DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) instead performs online reward optimization through the forward process. For multiple objectives, GDPO ( Liu et al., 2026e ) independently normalizes individual rewards before aggregation, but does not resolve cross-modal credit assignment when both modalities vary simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 广泛探索了奖励制后培训的推广和流动生成。 DDPO(Black等人,2023年)和DPOK(Fan等人,2023年)将反向去诺作为顺序的决策过程,并利用政策梯度优化推广模式. 最近,Flow-GRPO(Liu等人,2026年a)将确定性流采样转换成在线GRPO的等效结构过程。 传播NFT(郑等人,2026年)转而通过前期过程实现在线奖励优化. 对于多个目标,GDPO(Liu等人,2026e)独立地在汇总前实现个人奖励正常化,但当两种模式同时不同时,并不能解决跨模式信贷转让问题.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented AV-GRPO, a modality-anchored reinforcement learning framework for joint audio–video post-training. By combining anchored rollouts with alternating frozen-tower optimization, AV-GRPO disentangles rewards and controls comparison conditions, reduces training overhead, redirects credit assignment, and adapts to modality-specific dynamics and sample difficulty. We also introduced 5DAV, a five-dimensionally decoupled dataset for controllable post-training. Experiments on JavisBench and VABench show consistent improvements over LTX-2.3 and GDPO in perceptual quality, text alignment, and audio–video coherence and synchronization under both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These results demonstrate an effective and scalable approach to improving coupled audio–video generators.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了AV-GRPO,这是联合视听培训的强化学习框架。 AV-GRPO将固定式推出与旋转式冷冻塔优化结合起来,分散奖励和控制比较条件,减少培训间接费用,调整信贷分配,并适应模式特有的动态和抽样困难。 我们还引入了5DAV,一个五维解码数据集,用于可控的后培训. Javis Bench和VA Bench的实验显示,在LORA和全微调下,LTX-2.3和GDPO在感知质量、文本对齐以及音频-视频一致性和同步性方面都得到了持续改善。 这些结果表明,在改进组合式音频-视频发电机方面采取了有效和可扩展的办法。

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训详情

blocks.en:
All training runs, including LoRA and full fine-tuning, are conducted on a single 8-GPU A800 (80 GB) node.
All prompts in the training dataset are fully randomly shuffled (rather than sampled in category-ordered sequences).
Given a sampled prompt, the LTX-2.3 model generates audio-video clips with resolution 544 × 960 544\times 960 , 97 97 frames, and 24 24 FPS via 15-step denoising inference using the default random seed ( 42 42 ), producing 8 8 samples per prompt. The composition of the reward used to evaluate each audio-video sample is described in Appendix D . For LoRA training, the learning rate starts from 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} and decays to zero following a cosine schedule for 480 480 training steps (The total run is 1440 1440 steps, i.e., all data is seen once by each of the two towers: 5760 × 2 / 8 = 1440 5760\times 2/8=1440 ). The noise level for sampling of the video tower is set to 0.02 0.02 with a KL coefficient of 0.01 0.01 ; for the audio tower, the sampling noise level is 0.8 0.8 and the KL coefficient is 0.002 0.002 .
GDPO is trained for 480 steps under identical hyperparameters and the same data ordering. Since GDPO directly generates paired audio–video samples and updates both towers simultaneously, the same data is used to train each tower twice. For full fine-tuning, the learning rate starts at 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} with cosine decay to zero over 480 480 steps (keeping the same total step count). The noise levels and KL coefficients for both towers are kept identical to those used in LoRA training. Alternating optimization is adopted: training switches between the two towers every 4 4 steps, with 8 8 prompts consumed per step and the video tower updated first. Within each round, the video tower is first trained on 4 × 8 = 32 4\times 8=32 prompts. Training then switches to the audio tower, which is updated using the same set of 32 32 prompts, before proceeding to the next round with fresh data.
